tabs.html:
VSOL EPON OLT PON SFP Module 1.25G 9dBm PX20++++ | High-Performance Optical Transceiver for EPON & FTTH Networks


VSOL EPON OLT PON SFP Module 1.25G 9dBm PX20++++ is a high-performance optical transceiver designed for Ethernet Passive Optical Networks (EPON), offering seamless data transmission at 1.25 Gbps with a 9dBm optical output. With advanced PX20++++ technology, this module provides robust signal strength, making it ideal for EPON OLTs (Optical Line Terminals). Whether for FTTH (Fiber-to-the-Home) deployments or high-speed fiber-optic broadband networks, the VSOL EPON OLT PON SFP Module ensures stable long-distance transmission and is built for scalability, reliability, and cost-effectiveness. This module is a trusted choice for telecom providers, ISPs, and network operators seeking high-performance solutions for their EPON networks.


Key Features:

  • 1.25G Data Transmission: Ensures high-speed 1.25 Gbps downstream data transmission, ideal for EPON network and FTTH applications.
  • 9dBm Optical Power: Provides reliable 9dBm optical output power, ensuring optimal performance over long distances and minimal signal loss.
  • PX20++++ Technology: Cutting-edge PX20++++ technology enhances signal strength and network stability, even in demanding EPON infrastructure environments.
  • Seamless EPON Compatibility: Fully compatible with EPON OLTs and ONUs (Optical Network Units), ensuring smooth integration and hassle-free operation.
  • Ideal for FTTH: Perfect for providing fiber-optic broadband services in FTTH (Fiber-to-the-Home) networks, delivering fast and reliable internet to homes and businesses.
  • Scalable & Cost-Effective: A cost-effective solution that allows easy expansion of EPON networks without compromising performance.
  • Durable Design: Built to withstand environmental factors, ensuring long-term, stable performance in diverse conditions.


Applications:

  • Telecom Providers: Ideal for delivering reliable and scalable EPON network services.
  • FTTH Networks: Perfect for deploying fiber-to-the-home (FTTH) broadband connections for residential and business users.
  • ISPs & Network Operators: Best for scaling EPON networks and improving broadband delivery to customers.
